purpose: User-requested preliminary numerical comparison, NOT promotion validation
formal_gate_expected_failure: Historical price receipt and source availability uncertified
2025 previously researched, not an untouched holdout
training_source: Newly fetched official 2023/2024 K League 1 completed fixture results by stable official team IDs; received today, not historical receipts
evaluation: All 227 domestic 2025 K League 1 complete full-game 3-way markets uniquely matched to official 2025 fixtures; no odds or probability filters
baseline: src.devig.shin on the exact archived three-outcome prices; argmax, ties abstain

candidate.objective: SUM weighted negative joint goal log likelihood + 0.5*10*(sum attack_raw^2 + sum defence_raw^2 + rho^2); intercept/home unpenalized
candidate.identification: attack=raw-mean(raw), defence=raw-mean(raw); unknown promoted team uses zero effects until observed in training
candidate.fit: monthly expanding prior only, official result date <= month-start minus 7 days; min200 completed training fixtures; stop rather than silently market-fallback
candidate.result_availability: Seven-day source-date embargo is a retrospective modeling assumption, not verified historical publication/receipt
candidate.optimizer: L-BFGS-B analytic gradient, maxiter2000, ftol1e-11, gtol1e-7; stop on failure
candidate.goals_grid: 0..30 each side, reject tail >1e-10; normalize remaining joint mass
candidate.choice: argmax 3-way probability, 1e-12 ties abstain; no EV/odds/underdog filters

decision: No automatic adoption/deployment. Report all signed effects and uncertainty, label results exploratory regardless of sign; evaluate independent period and formal gates before any replacement
wallet: Unit diagnostic does not alter operating monthly loss limit 50000 KRW or execute bets
